infrastructure.name: docker-compose.yml
infrastructure.summary: Full local development stack orchestrating six services: a pgvector Postgres database, database migration runner, Keycloak OIDC identity provider, Next.js app server, background job worker, and an optional admin elevation helper â€” all wired with health checks and dependency ordering.

infrastructure.name: db
infrastructure.summary: Postgres 17 database service with the pgvector extension, used for all relational data and vector similarity search.

infrastructure.name: migrate
infrastructure.summary: One-shot migration runner that applies pending node-pg-migrate migrations to the Postgres database before the app or worker services start.

infrastructure.name: keycloak
infrastructure.summary: Keycloak 26.2 OIDC identity provider pre-seeded from a realm JSON file, serving as the authentication backend for the app and worker services.

infrastructure.name: app
infrastructure.summary: Next.js application container built from the Dockerfile runner stage, exposed on port 3000 and configured with OIDC auth pointing at the local Keycloak instance.

infrastructure.name: worker
infrastructure.summary: Background job worker container built from the Dockerfile worker stage, sharing the uploads volume with the app and connecting to the app over the internal Docker network.

infrastructure.name: elevate-demo-user
infrastructure.summary: Optional one-off helper service (tools profile) that promotes the Keycloak demo user to admin role via a direct SQL UPDATE, intended to be run manually after first login.

infrastructure.name: Dockerfile
infrastructure.summary: Four-stage multi-target Dockerfile: a builder stage that compiles the Next.js app, a minimal runner stage serving the standalone Next.js server on port 3000 as a non-root user, a worker stage reusing the runner filesystem with a different entrypoint, and a lightweight migrate stage that runs node-pg-migrate against the database.

infrastructure.name: builder
infrastructure.summary: Build stage that installs all npm dependencies and compiles the Next.js application into standalone output.

infrastructure.name: runner
infrastructure.summary: Minimal production runtime image that copies only the Next.js standalone bundle, static assets, public files, and worker scripts from the builder stage, running as a non-root nextjs user.

infrastructure.name: worker
infrastructure.summary: Worker stage that extends the runner image with a different CMD to launch the background job worker process instead of the Next.js server.

infrastructure.name: migrate
infrastructure.summary: Lightweight migration stage that installs only production dependencies and copies the migrations directory, running node-pg-migrate on startup.

infrastructure.name: ci.yml
infrastructure.summary: GitHub Actions CI workflow that runs ESLint, TypeScript type checking, Vitest tests, and database migrations in parallel before a final Next.js production build; triggered on PRs targeting main or dev and supports manual dispatch.

infrastructure.name: Lint
infrastructure.summary: CI job that installs Node 20 dependencies and runs ESLint to enforce code style rules.

infrastructure.name: Type Check
infrastructure.summary: CI job that installs Node 20 dependencies and runs tsc --noEmit to validate TypeScript types across the project.

infrastructure.name: Tests
infrastructure.summary: CI job that installs Node 20 dependencies and runs the Vitest test suite.

infrastructure.name: Migrations
infrastructure.summary: CI job that spins up a pgvector Postgres 17 service container and runs node-pg-migrate to validate all pending database migrations before the build.

infrastructure.name: Build
infrastructure.summary: Final CI job gated on lint, typecheck, tests, and migrations that produces a Next.js production build using the NEXTAUTH_SECRET repository secret.
